THE SALT ROAD
Written by A. Nonymous


FADE IN:

1  EXT. COASTAL HIGHWAY - DAY

A battered pickup truck grinds along a cliff road. Below, the sea.

MARA
We're losing daylight.

DRIVER
Then stop talking and watch the road.

Mara checks a rifle wrapped in canvas at her feet.

2  INT. ROADSIDE DINER - NIGHT

Fluorescent hum. A dog sleeps under the counter.

MARA
Two coffees. Black.

WAITRESS
You look like 1943 walked in.

MARA (CONT'D)
Feels about right.

3  EXT. COASTAL HIGHWAY - NIGHT

The truck sits dark. A child watches from the treeline.

4  INT/EXT. TRUCK CAB - CONTINUOUS

Rain on glass.

DRIVER
Nobody follows us out here.

5  EXT. HARBOUR - DAWN

Boats knock together. A horse is led down the quay.

MARA
This is where it ends.

FADE OUT.
